title: Project settings
timezoneHint: Attendance window starts after work end and ends 1 min before next work start.
autoAttendanceHint: When on, attendance is taken daily at 21:00 in the project timezone for active workers. Supervisors remove no-shows from the attendance list with “Didn’t come”.
closureWarning: Data is not deleted immediately. Personnel have 30 days to consent and download records; the project is removed after the deadline. Download the full project archive first.
